blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police intercepted a motorized boat carrying over P7.2 million worth of alleged smuggled cigarettes and arrested eight crew members during a seaborne operation in the coastal waters off Barangay Sinunuc, Zamboanga City on Thursday morning. Police Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, Police Regional Office 9 (PRO-9) spokesperson, reported that personnel from the 2nd Zamboanga City Mobile Force Company (ZCMFC), operating alongside the Regional Intelligence Division and the Zamboanga City Police Office, spotted a motorized wooden watercraft locally known as a jungkung at around 3:45 a.m. near Acapulco Beach.
